title: Write an honest model report
summary: A useful model report explains the task, data, checks and limits. Readers need enough detail to know where the result may fail.
introduction: A useful model report explains the task, data, checks and limits. Readers need enough detail to know where the result may fail. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain write an honest model report
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A useful model report explains the task, data, checks and limits. Readers need enough detail to know where the result may fail.

blocks.code:
Task: estimate reading minutes
Data: fictional page-and-time pairs
Check: compare held-out errors with a simple baseline
Limit: too little data for real learners
Decision: keep this as a classroom demonstration
blocks.title: Write an honest model report

blocks.text: The report connects a result to its limits. It does not claim the toy model knows how all children read.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add one question you would ask before collecting any real learner data.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Keep private information out of practice data and include a human review for important decisions.
For more detail later, use this [Machine Learning further reading](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course).
